decisions.capability: Read native provider usage without mixing counter scopes
decisions.evidence_scope: Offline native usage parsing and scoped current-session observations have retained outputs.
limitations: Provider consumption, estimated savings, billing and cache subsets are distinct.
Repeated cumulative snapshots cannot be summed as additional usage.
decisions.next_gap: Resolve missing attempt/child coverage before any whole-workflow efficiency claim.

decisions.capability: Resolve persistent native command and MCP environments
decisions.evidence_scope: Fresh native processes resolved selected commands/MCP servers and Claude startup hooks; restarted Desktop source retrieval has its own dated receipt.
limitations: Configuration presence does not prove an already-running task hot-reloaded it.
The Linux/WSL and Desktop process/configuration boundaries remain distinct.
decisions.next_gap: Collect the specific new-host or changed-session activation evidence; do not copy account stores.

decisions.capability: Process large tool output while preserving useful source facts
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected explicit native calls and exact artifact checks passed; paired trials retain both a Codex reduction and a Claude increase. The later six-attempt selective-policy pilot passed its fixture checks but made zero Context Mode calls.
limitations: Cache conditions were uncontrolled and enclosing workflow usage was incomplete.
The foundation gateway RTK/lite previews failed required semantic checks; general CLI acceptance does not repair those failures.
The selective-policy pilot's +2.42% aggregate token difference is not a causal Context Mode measurement; its rejected first attempt remains retained.
decisions.next_gap: Measure only a concrete changed workload, with correctness and complete attempt accounting.

existing_overturn_when: A frozen task/artifact and repeated controlled comparison improves answer correctness or retrieval completeness while reducing complete provider use or latency, with successful raw-input recovery.
limitations: The current native tasks have no matched baseline; counters, bytes avoided, artifact token counts and provider usage must not be summed.
TOON expands the full catalog relative to compact JSON; guarded compression must return originals on rejection. Exact whole-PC lifetime savings are unmeasured.
requirement: Supply useful task context with recoverable originals and measure artifact reductions separately from provider usage.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
